description:
We are seeking a dedicated and compassionate Certified Occupational Therapy Assistant (COTA) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Gainesville, FL. This full-time role offers a fantastic opportunity to contribute to patient recovery and enhance their quality of life within a supportive environment. You will work closely with occupational therapists to implement individualized treatment plans, helping patients regain independence and achieve their rehabilitation goals.

As a COTA, you will assist patients with therapeutic exercises, activities of daily living, and the use of adaptive equipment. This full-time position comes with a competitive hourly rate, providing a stable and rewarding career path for a motivated professional.
requirements: Associate's degree from an accredited COTA program
Current and valid Florida COTA licensure/certification
Experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting preferred
Ability to work effectively as part of a multidisciplinary therapy team
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate for COTA/PTA is $28.00 - $37.00. Hourly rate for PT/OT/ST is $40.00 - $50.00.

description:
We are seeking a dedicated and compassionate Registered Nurse (RN) to join a premier home health agency in Casper, WY. This full-time position offers a unique opportunity to provide high-quality, patient-centered care in a home setting, making a direct impact on the lives of individuals within the community.

As a Home Health RN, you will be responsible for delivering skilled nursing services, managing patient care plans, and educating patients and their families. We offer a competitive hourly rate and a supportive environment where your clinical expertise will be valued.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Wyoming
Minimum of one year of clinical nursing experience
Strong assessment, critical thinking, and communication skills
Ability to work independently and manage a caseload effectively
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate of $36.00 - $45.00, based on experience.

description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced PM&R Physician to join a dynamic network of health and rehabilitation centers in Queens, NY. This role offers a highly competitive compensation package starting over $300,000 annually, with a strong emphasis on performance-based bonuses. You will have the opportunity to make a significant impact by providing specialized care across multiple facilities, typically working 1-2 days per week at each location.
The ideal candidate will possess a robust background in workers' compensation or no-fault (NF)/lien cases, as our practice focuses exclusively on these areas, not major medical insurance, Medicare, or Medicaid. This position requires flexibility, including the ability to work weekends, to ensure comprehensive patient care. If you are a board-certified PM&R Physician with a passion for rehabilitation and a proven track record in workers' compensation, we encourage you to apply.
Join a team committed to excellence and patient recovery, where your expertise in physical medicine and rehabilitation will be highly valued. This is an urgent opening for a physician ready to thrive in a bonus-heavy compensation structure.
requirements: Doctor of Medicine (MD) degree and valid New York state medical license
Board Certification in Physical Medicine & Rehabilitation (PM&R)
Minimum of 2 years of experience with Workers' Compensation (WC) or No-Fault (NF)/Lien cases
Ability to work weekends as needed
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation starts over $300,000 annually, with a very heavy emphasis on bonuses rather than base salary.
